# Room 3, Potting Nook: generated by make_env.py from its grid (do not edit by hand).
# A tiled bench (a violet and teal slate checker, white pads sunk in), violet planter-box walls under mint hedges (low where floor lies
# behind them, so the camera sees over), a violet skirt; bushes, flowers and pots on the walls.
# Up Z, the room's far row towards +Y; origin at the room's centre, the floor's top at z 0.
new
material new Tile --base-color 0.392 0.380 0.761 --no-slot
material new TileB --base-color 0.169 0.663 0.706 --no-slot
material new Pad --base-color 0.941 0.965 0.910 --no-slot
material new Planter --base-color 0.392 0.380 0.761 --no-slot
material new Hedge --base-color 0.576 0.831 0.710 --no-slot
material new Bench --base-color 0.392 0.380 0.761 --no-slot
material new Bush --base-color 0.169 0.663 0.706 --no-slot
material new Bloom --base-color 0.890 0.604 0.675 --no-slot
material new Pot --base-color 0.769 0.365 0.624 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Room --size 1 --x-subdivisions 7 --y-subdivisions 6 --location 0 0 0
scale 7 6 1
apply --scale
material assign Tile
mode edit
select mode face
select face where "(abs(pos.x - -3.00) < 0.3 && abs(pos.y - 2.50) < 0.3)"

select face where "(floor(pos.x + 20.25) + floor(pos.y + 20.25)) % 2 == 0"
